why: The repository targets the M5Stack Cardputer-Adv (repository description: "ISS Tracker for the Cardputer Adv"), a different board from the original Cardputer (Stamp-S3A with a TCA8418 I2C keyboard, ES8311, BMI270, versus the original's GPIO key matrix), and states no support for the original. The m5cardputer recipe was Jr's old 'Cardputer ADV -> m5cardputer' mapping; the edge now lives in m5cardputer-adv__cardputer-iss-tracker. ADV-only in two independent blind audits (review room entries 12118 and 12122).
